product_one_liner.value: An AI-native financial-crime compliance platform that helps financial institutions and compliance teams screen customers and payments, monitor transactions, and automate risk decisions.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes an AI-native financial-crime platform that automates compliance and risk decisions; the product knowledge base says compliance teams use Mesh to screen clients and monitor behavior.

pricing_page.notes: The official site has a Pricing page that lists Starter and Enterprise options and pricing information.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: ComplyAdvantage’s official customer stories include a Tala screening case study and a BigPay screening case study. | named_customers.0: The cited official customer story identifies Tala as a customer. | named_customers.1: The cited official customer story identifies BigPay as a customer.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Gartner identifies London as ComplyAdvantage’s head office city. | hq_country: Gartner identifies the head office as London, United Kingdom, supporting the country value.

founded_year.notes: Gartner lists ComplyAdvantage Mesh as founded in 2014 in its company details.

eng_blog.notes: The dedicated ComplyAdvantage Technology Blog index lists multiple technical posts, including LLM extraction and Elasticsearch architecture topics; an accompanying post identifies its author as a Junior Engineer and discusses the company’s engineering environment. This meets the threshold for a technical blog, though the index does not state every author’s job title.

public_docs.notes: ComplyAdvantage has public Mesh API documentation with guides and a large API reference, in addition to its public legacy API documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Greenhouse board lists 13 roles under Commercial and Marketing, and none of the listed job titles is an AI, ML, data-science, NLP, LLM, or computer-vision role.

model_provider.notes: ComplyAdvantage’s official 2026 article says large language models such as Google Gemini are hosted in its controlled environment.
